query: SELECT pa.id, pa.name, pa.tradeName, po.supplierId, COUNT(po.id) as cnt FROM purchaseOrders po LEFT JOIN partners pa ON po.supplierId = pa.id WHERE po.status = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY po.supplierId, pa.id, pa.name, pa.tradeName ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 20;
